author: NovaLikesPvP
body:
Hey Guys.

Well, I was tempbanned 5 days ago of Void Logging on Avicus [ Nebula ].
First, I was correctly tempbanned by FrozenThorns, On that exact second I disconnected when I was falling to the void, So I was correctly punished by him.
On that day, My Internet went unconfigured so I had about 300 to 400 ms on the Avicus Server, ( Normally I play with 140 - 150 ms ), So I had some Rage and I void logged once because the block lag, The lag that led me to an ealier point when I jump and bow with 3 seconds of delay.. I came really angry with my internet and I started to void log and some minutes later I had my correctly punish.

I´m not trying to justify my actions, I´m really sorry and I doesn´t Void log anytime, but at that moment I was really rage, so please give me an opportunity, I´m really sorry.

Thanks for reading and sorry for the people who I Void Logged, I´m really sorry.
           
  
Regards,


- NovaLikesPvP.

replies.body:
Hello NovaLikesPvP,

You have broken the rules and you must face the consequences. You only have 2 days left to wait which isn't long at all. Whilst you are some what remorseful, which i can see, you need to understand that every action has a consequence. Finish the 2 days, this appeal is denied. 

Regards,

Posighdun - Avicus Network Senior Moderator
